text: {"lessons":["Selling winners and later buying the same stocks does not ensure better results; I should base trades on current portfolio needs, not the satisfaction of realizing gains.","Buying several stocks at once can leave me exposed to a broad decline, so I should consider position sizes and diversification before committing cash.","With unpredictable prices and a long-term approach, I should not treat a few months of gains or losses as a reason to trade; I should review my plan and make deliberate decisions."]}
